capabilities: Export Markdown files to PDF from the Finder context menu
Export files outside the vault without importing or opening them
Resolve filename conflicts with automatic numbered names
Generate the Finder Quick Action with a Python setup script
disambiguation: Not a file search or PDF-reading tool; it adds one macOS Finder context-menu action that renders Markdown to PDF.
extras: macOS-only and desktop-only; requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; cold start may still show the main window; relies on Obsidian internal APIs, so future updates may need retesting; triggers the directory's Direct Filesystem Access warning.
intentEvidence: using Obsidian's native PDF renderer and your vault's export settings
problem: Obsidian's PDF export requires opening notes in the app and works on vault files, so Markdown in arbitrary folders cannot be exported from Finder without importing it.

requires.name: Python 3 (only to generate the Quick Action)

summary: macOS Finder Quick Action that exports Markdown files, including ones outside the vault, to PDF using Obsidian's native renderer.
